# unifi_network_site (Data Source)

Look up a UniFi site by its slug (internal reference). Defaults to the provider's configured site.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolve the configured site (or pass `name` for another slug) to its UUID.
data "unifi_network_site" "current" {}

output "site_uuid" {
  value = data.unifi_network_site.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Site slug (internal reference, e.g. `default`). Defaults to the provider's `site`.

### Read-Only

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable site name (e.g. `Default`).
- `id` (String) Integration site UUID.
- `internal_reference` (String) Site slug used by the legacy/v2 surfaces.
